textPlacement.assessment: The contexts preserve the chart’s early small-jug and small-liquid example, the later appendix row and adult help with spills across the browsing ages.
The contexts support fetching or returning shoes as a shared, manageable contribution with reachable storage and a seat, without requiring independent dressing.
The contexts preserve steady walking for watering, the separate leaf-care ages and later cut-stem flower-arranging and gardening examples.
The contexts distinguish carrying dirty clothing from later sorting and supervised hanging, while allowing a small shared part at every placement.
The contexts preserve the earlier wiping and cleaning-caption examples, the walking condition for table wiping and later appendix dusting and sweeping labels.
The new age context retains assisted preparation, separate cutting examples and later preschool knife readiness rather than authorizing all tools at the browsing age.
The new context follows the eighteen-month-to-three-year shopping chart and keeps the child’s real contribution manageable with adult help and realistic expectations.
The contexts distinguish the earlier plate-return task from fuller later setting and clearing while retaining manageable items, shared work and optional guides.
